coding_protocol.input_coverage: Every history input enters every coordinate of every Hadamard view
coding_protocol.output: No intermediate demux or gains; final-only fixed row-normalized 512-to-96 projection with unit-init learned gains
coding_protocol.note: Embedding stays in history; append separate post-attention view+RWKV update and raw KS2 coordinates at each layer. KS2 reads history plus current post-attention state. All depth gradients retained. No 2048D side stream. Final head reads only final demux; no residual bypass. Initial logits differ from earlier residual models.

demuxed_history.note: Independent GPU runs; no tensor parallelism. Warmup/benchmark updates reset.

coding_protocol.fold: signed orthonormal 8-way Hadamard groups; sum groups / sqrt(group count)
coding_protocol.input_coverage: Every current main/side feature and every historical 96D feature enters every coordinate of every subspace
coding_protocol.output: Unchanged baseline fixed output matrix with unit row norms and zero-init learned gains
coding_protocol.note: History contains post-residual-addition main states from attention and FFN separately, in chronological order for all strictly previous layers. No detach or extra attention. LayerNorm and causal FFN time mix cover the expanded input; current-stream mix initialization is preserved. History is read-only; output updates only current main/side. Width-dependent input codes change; geometry/output initialization matches the baseline.

demuxed_history.architecture: four KS2 FFNs; 96D attention/embedding/head; FFN-only side residual; separate post-attention and post-FFN main residual history
